# Explore activity and work statistics
<!-- generated by docs:update_by_ai -->
<!-- page type: how-to -->

Open the Statistics window to review user activity, Git history, and estimated AI cost.

## Open Statistics

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_window.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/StatisticsModal.vue -->

Open the **More** menu and choose **Statistics**. Select a tab in the window to view its data.

## Explore user activity

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_user_activity.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_user_activity_stacked_bars.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_user_activity_vertical_axis.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_totals.md -->

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/glossary/user_activity.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/UserActivityTab.vue -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/UserActivityHistogram.vue -->

Choose the time range and workspaces shown in the **User activity** tab. Read the stacked chart by workspace; point to a bar to see its details. The window remembers supported selections between visits.

![The tab "User activity" of the Statistics window: the histogram of the last day with one bar for each hour, and the information card of one bar with the time of each workspace.](/screenshots/features/statistics_user_activity.png)

## Explore one person's work

<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_person_work.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_person_work_inputs.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_person_work_legend_filter.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_person_work_slots.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_person_work_workspace.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_git_history.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_ai_cost.md -->
<!-- source: docs/agents_rules/user_interface/window/statistics_update_stages.md -->
<!-- source: packages/apps/web_frontend/src/components/StatisticsModal.vue -->

In **Work of one person**, choose a person, source, time range, and workspace. Select chart legend entries to filter the chart; each chart keeps its own filter. Git history and AI cost are separate sources, and the values are summaries rather than direct measures of all work.

![The tab "Work of one person" of the Statistics window with the source "Git history": the three totals, and one bar for each of the last 7 days with the commits and the pull requests.](/screenshots/features/statistics_person_work.png)
